corrections.P1-03_exclusivity: PCM->Native is refused while a PCM source owns the output; Native->PCM load/seek/volume/mute are refused; sync and async transport paths share the guards; ownership clears on confirmed release/host loss
corrections.P2-01_playing_confirmation: start/pause/resume confirm the real GStreamer state before success; a request alone is never published; executor rejects an unconfirmed host result
corrections.DTO_readback: host observations require strict strings/ints/bools and the real source path; fabricated linked/generation/path/stable-device evidence is rejected before commit
